items.title: Lew Soloff interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 16, 2000
items.q: There were several guys that did it. Frank, the keyboard player did some of it.

ctx.x: Who put all the music together, chart-wise, for the horns and all that?

Well it was difficult. There were 30 songs. There were several guys that did it. Frank, the keyboard player did some of it. There was another guy on the west coast that at the last minute was called in too. We basically, since they were covering a lot of records, in other words like they would do famous R&B recordings done by other artists, like it was an homage to Rhythm & Blues.
